transcript: Okay, is it recording? Right. So this is everything from the wardrobe clear-out. First one, Levi's denim jacket, the trucker one. I've had it since sixth form, it's a medium. It's a bit faded on the collar and there's a tiny mark on the sleeve, just there. Next, this Nike sweatshirt, it's from the nineties, it was my dad's, he wore it to five-a-side for years. Size large. Then this, Lakers jersey, Kobe, number 24, and it's signed by Kobe Bryant. My uncle got it signed in LA in 2009 when he was out there for work, it's just been sat in a drawer ever since. This denim jacket, my sister painted it, she's at Central Saint Martins. All the lettering on the front is done by hand, took her weeks. There's no label, it fits like a medium. I want £80 for it, honestly, she'd kill me if it went for less. This jumper, got it at a car boot, no label on it but it's proper wool, bit scratchy. Fits a large. And last one, St Michael dress, the old M&S one, size 12. It's missing the belt but otherwise it's perfect. That's it, that's the lot.
